title: Novel Frame Buffer Pixel Circuits for Liquid-Crystal-on-Silicon Microdisplays
figure_number: Fig. 3. Frame buffer pixel circuits. a) Proposed by Shields.b) Proposed by McKnight.
function_summary: Novel Frame Buffer Pixel Circuits: A 32 16 liquid-crystal-on-silicon (LCOS) backplane with novel frame buffer pixels is designed and fabricated using the AMI Semiconductor’s 0.5m double-poly triple-metal CMOS process.
